known_rules.symptom: Same-size body with a different register or clear order; the candidate's emission predecessor differs from the historical predecessor
known_rules.known_source_cause: GCC 4.4.1 emits functions in call-graph order derived from definition order and carries scratch-register and clear-order state between consecutively compiled functions. main.c emission order agreed with history at 33%; restoring historical definition order raised agreement to 90% and flipped play_sound to exact while regressing two neighbors.
known_rules.known_fix_pattern: Recover in historical emission order from the frontier (all earlier functions exact and in order). Move a single unchanged definition after its historical predecessor only when tools/emission_order.py records a gain with no regression; never reorder the whole file while neighbors are still DIFFER.
